title: Lecturer in Mechanical Engineering
description:
Lecturer in Mechanical Engineering (Apprenticeships)

Please apply by 06/12/2026

Full time

£28,273 - £42,655. Plus a potential market premium of up to £5,000 per annum for candidates with a PGCE, a relevant degree, a master’s qualification and relevant industry experience.

As a Mechanical Engineering Lecturer, you will be part of a dedicated curriculum team, playing a key role in the delivery, planning and development of high-quality engineering programmes. You will teach across apprenticeship and commercial provision, helping learners to develop the technical knowledge, practical skills and professional behaviours required for a successful career in industry.

You will support students throughout their learning journey, creating an engaging and inclusive environment that enables them to achieve their potential. Working collaboratively with colleagues and employers, you will contribute to curriculum development, maintain high standards of teaching and learning, and ensure that programmes reflect current industry practice.

What Are We Looking For?

We are seeking a suitably qualified Mechanical Engineering professional with relevant industrial experience, particularly within machining and/or maintenance engineering. You will have a strong understanding of current developments within the Mechanical Engineering sector and be passionate about sharing your knowledge and expertise with the next generation of engineers.

The successful candidate will be able to inspire and support young people in their personal and professional development, demonstrating excellent communication skills and a commitment to high-quality teaching and learning. Experience of working with young people or adults within an education or training environment would be advantageous, as would experience of delivering commercial training to groups.

Knowledge of engineering software and ICT systems such as Fusion 360, Inventor and AutoCAD would be beneficial. Experience of G-code programming, CNC setting and machining, CAM programming and machining would also be highly desirable, enabling you to bring current industry practices into the classroom and workshop.

What makes Blackburn College an Employer of choice?

You'll have access to a wide range of benefits and support, including, but not limited to:

  • Employee Assistance Programme with a 24/7/365 helpline for advice and support
  • Regular Staff Physical Activity Sessions and reduced-price gym membership
  • Cycle to Work Scheme
  • Discounted Bus Travel with the Transdev Commuter Club
  • Family-friendly policies
  • Free eye tests and contribution to VDU-use-only glasses
  • Several food outlets with a variety of menu choices
  • A full range of discounted professional Hair & Beauty services provided by the Academy Salon
  • Professional bakery offering a variety of fresh breads, cakes, and ready meals
